args.message: Here is each store's best 2025 month by pre-tax sales (net_sales), compared with its average month. December was the best month for four stores; Brooklyn peaked in March and Philadelphia in January. A store's average counts only months with sales, which are the months it was open. Los Angeles has 2 months (Nov–Dec), New Orleans has 8 (May–Dec) and the others have 12. The averages for those two newer stores include a partial opening month, which pulls them down. That partly explains why their best months sit so far above average: New Orleans was 71% above and Los Angeles 27% above. Los Angeles's figure rests on only two months.
